title: Intelinside result
description: One benchmark result, committed as results/<your-github-handle>/<name>.json. Ids come from the hardware, model, quant, and runtime catalog in frontend/src/catalog/. The pull request check validates the ids; this schema covers the shape.

rig.description: The number at the end of your rig's URL on the site, or the rig's exact name. The rig must be yours.

component.description: Hardware id of the one part the run used, for example intel-arc-b580. Leave out for a whole-rig result.

componentQuantity.description: How many of that part were used. Needs component.

quant.description: Quant id, for example int4 or q4_k_m. Must be one the model has a board for.

runtime.description: Runtime id, for example llamacpp, cascadia, openvino-genai.

runtimeFlags.description: Flags and settings behind the run: backend, attention kernel, KV cache precision. Optional, for example "-fa 1 -ngl 99, SYCL backend".

customRuntime.description: The custom runtime this ran on: the number at the end of its URL on the site, or its exact name. Omit for a stock run on the released runtime.

revision.description: The exact engine revision behind this number — a commit hash, a tag, or a build id. Recommended for stock and custom runs alike: engines change week to week.

decodeTps.description: Decode tokens per second. This is what ranks.

ttftMs.description: Time to first token, in milliseconds.

contextLength.description: Legacy and ambiguous (prompt tokens or context window). Use inputTokens for the prompt length.

batchSize.description: Legacy and ambiguous (concurrent requests or engine batch size). Use concurrency for simultaneous requests.

inputTokens.description: Prompt tokens actually sent, after the chat template.

concurrency.description: Simultaneous requests. 1 for a single stream.

decodeScope.description: Only with concurrency above 1: whether decodeTps is each request's rate or total throughput across requests.

decodeMethod.description: How decode was timed: streamed rate after the first token, the engine's own timing, llama-bench tg, or wall clock including prefill.

repeats.description: Measured runs behind the number, not counting warm-up.

promptCache.description: Whether a cached prompt was reused.

speculative.description: Speculative decoding: none, lossless (output unchanged, e.g. MTP or a draft model with exact verification), or lossy.

evidenceUrl.description: Optional HTTPS link to benchmark logs, scripts, a gist, a report, or a repository. The submission PR is recorded separately.

result.description: The result's URL on the site once submitted. Added when the file is written from a result page.

customRuntimeFile.description: Registration file added in this PR. Mutually exclusive with customRuntime.
